segments.text: Think power is everything in a car? Think again! The Maruti Suzuki Swift is the ultimate proof that you don't need a beast of an engine to leave the competition in the dust .
With its efficient 1.2-litre engine, the Swift prioritizes smarts over brute force .
Don't get it twisted though - it still packs a punch with 82 P-S and 111.7 N-m of torque, making it perfect for city drives and beyond .
And when it comes to stretching your fuel, the Swift's got you covered with an impressive mileage of 25.75 kmpl - because who doesn't love saving money on fuel ?

The Swift's estimated price range is 5.79 lakh to 8.80 lakh, but the real showstopper is the ZXi variant, loaded with goodies like LED projector headlamps, 15-inch alloy wheels, a 9-inch touchscreen, and more - giving you the most bang for your buck.
Rear AC vents - the ultimate game-changer. If your car doesn't have them, are you really living your best life?
So, Swift or not so Swift? Let us know in the comments! Follow for more car reviews that'll keep you entertained and informed
